diagnostics.message:
[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run1]
`:resource.azapi_resource.diag_settings` configures `workspaceId` from the management module's generated configuration, but does not depend on `:resource.azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.management`. The diagnostic setting can be created before the workspace it targets exists.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run2]
The diagnostic settings use the Log Analytics workspace resource ID through a computed local but have no dependency on the workspace resource. Ordering the diagnostics after the workspace avoids creating settings against a workspace that is not yet provisioned.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]
The diagnostic-settings resource uses the Log Analytics workspace ID as its destination, but its configuration is supplied through locals/template variables and has no dependency on the managed workspace. If the workspace is created in this apply, diagnostic settings can be attempted before the destination exists.
